row.title: A red deploy gate is repaired by bisection, not by a model (REDMAIN-1, GATE-PARITY-1)
row.body: 2026-11-19: a swept branch changed one character in site/webbotauth.js. checks did not run the site tests, so the merge was green and deploy-site was red for 29 hours; the code agent did not fix it. Now checks and deploy-site run scripts/site_tests.sh, and ciwatch runs foundation redmain, which bisects main to the first bad commit and opens the smallest revert that turns the gate green. TOKEN-EXPIRY-1 (foundation credwatch) probes token and domain expiry daily; GATE-SETTLE-1 closes an owner gate on its own evidence.
